#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long fast_power(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fast_power(p, p - 1) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << fast_power(p, p) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    long long a = k, order = 1;
    while (a != 1) {
        a = (a * k) % p;
        order++;
    }
    cout << fast_power(p, (p - 1) / order) << endl;
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
